Three town tools parse a letter's frontmatter with three copies of the same rule. tools/envelope.mjs (the law: it delivers and pre-checks) requires the file to open with '---' plus a newline; tools/lint.mjs and tools/witness.mjs accept a bare '---'. So a letter can lint clean and still bounce, or the witness can certify one the ferry refuses. The fix: lint and witness import envelope.mjs's parser instead of keeping their own.
payload.title: The envelope law is forked three ways: lint and witness disagree with the ferry

fields.steps: Read the three guards side by side at town main: tools/envelope.mjs:40 (startsWith('---\n')), tools/lint.mjs:35 and tools/witness.mjs:321 (startsWith('---')). A file opening '---' with CRLF or trailing text passes lint and witness and is refused by the ferry.
